name: Local Image Generation (Stable Diffusion)
purpose: Generate one image from a text prompt with a local Stable Diffusion pipeline. Drives a diffusers pipeline (fp16, CUDA) via a Python worker (gen_image_infer.py) under the speech venv with a meta-file hand-off to a PowerShell wrapper (the D-0021 speech.tts pattern). Two model/tier families selected from models.json (type=image-gen, decoupled from the gateway wired gate): the DEFAULT image.sd15 (Stable Diffusion 1.5, StableDiffusionPipeline, ~2.6 GB VRAM -- the fast legacy tier, CreativeML OpenRAIL-M) and image.sd35-medium (Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, StableDiffusion3Pipeline, fp16 + model CPU offload + VAE tiling with a sequential-offload OOM fallback, T5-XXL kept CPU-side; the higher-quality tier, Stability Community License). params.pipeline in the model entry selects the family. Binds the CUDA context / VRAM, so parallel_safe:false. Populates confidence (a generation-completeness / non-blank heuristic) + model_provenance and routes failed / blank / low-confidence generations to the review queue (the eighth producer). The neural generation counterpart of image.interpret (#17, which reads an image) and gen.audio (#22, which synthesizes sound).

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Prompt <text> (required); -NegativePrompt <text>; -Width <n> (512) -Height <n> (512) (multiples of 8, 128..1024, w*h<=1048576); -Steps <n> (20; 1..150); -Guidance <n> (7.5; 0..30); -Seed <n> (-1 = random; actual seed recorded); -Scheduler <dpm++|euler|euler_a|ddim> (dpm++); -Format <png|jpg|webp> (png); -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1> (0.5, review floor); -Model <model_id> | -Tier <alias>; overrides -Registry/-PythonPath/-GenInferPath/-ReviewQueuePath. OR -InputsJson '<json {prompt,negative_prompt,width,height,steps,guidance,seed,scheduler,format,confidence_threshold,model,tier,registry,python_path,gen_infer_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.
invocation.engine: diffusers StableDiffusionPipeline (fp16, CUDA; Python worker under the speech venv)

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.description: Text describing what to avoid (e.g. 'blurry, lowres, watermark').

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Image width in px (multiple of 8, 128..1024; width*height <= 1048576).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Image height in px (multiple of 8, 128..1024; width*height <= 1048576).

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Number of denoising steps (1..150). More = slower, usually higher quality.

inputs.name: guidance
inputs.description: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale (0..30). Higher = follow the prompt more strictly.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed. -1 = random (the actual chosen seed is recorded). A fixed seed >= 0 is reproducible on this GPU.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Sampler: dpm++ (DPMSolverMultistep) | euler | euler_a (Euler ancestral) | ddim.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output image format: png | jpg | webp.

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Envelope confidence below this routes the generation to the review queue (verify_generation).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: image-gen model_id in models.json (type=image-gen). Default = defaults.image (image.sd15).

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: image tier alias resolved via tiers.image. A named -Model wins.

models: image.sd15 (Stable Diffusion 1.5 diffusers fp16; CreativeML OpenRAIL-M; default fast tier)
image.sd35-medium (Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium diffusers fp16; Stability Community License; quality tier, CPU offload + VAE tiling on the 11 GB card)
requirements.gpu: cuda (RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB; SD1.5 ~2.6 GB VRAM at 512x512; SD3.5 Medium fp16 with model/sequential CPU offload + VAE tiling)
